name: renders ordinary scores and pre-deuce ties
input: empty, uneven, and tied rally sequences
test:
assert tennis_game_score([]) == 'Love-All'
assert tennis_game_score(['B', 'A', 'B']) == '15-30'
assert tennis_game_score(['A', 'B', 'A', 'B']) == '30-All'
assert tennis_game_score(['A', 'A', 'B']) == '30-15'

name: distinguishes deuce and either advantage
input: six alternating rallies followed by one more rally
test:
deuce = ['A', 'B', 'A', 'B', 'A', 'B']
assert tennis_game_score(deuce) == 'Deuce'
assert tennis_game_score(deuce + ['A']) == 'Advantage A'
assert tennis_game_score(deuce + ['B']) == 'Advantage B'

name: requires a two-point lead to finish the game
input: a straight win and a win after deuce
test:
assert tennis_game_score(['A', 'A', 'A', 'A']) == 'Game A'
assert tennis_game_score(['A', 'B', 'A', 'B', 'A', 'B', 'B', 'B']) == 'Game B'
